Canada & USA

Build Something Bigger Than a Sales Territory. Build a Market.

Innostrat™ is looking for a proven industrial sales hunter
who can identify opportunities, build customer relationships, and close complex technical solutions.
If you have successfully sold industrial automation systems, robotic work cells, inspection gauges, CNC machining services, or advanced technology products

You will work alongside executive leadership and engineering teams to drive revenue growth, expand into new markets, and help commercialize innovative technologies.

About Innostrat™

Innostrat™ is an ISO 9001:2015 certified and CGP-registered
advanced manufacturing company specializing in:
Industrial Automation & Robotics
Custom Inspection Gauges & Metrology Solutions
Multi-Axis CNC Machining
CAD/CAM & Engineering Services
R&D and Product Development
Advanced Industrial Technology Solutions
Our customers operate in automotive, aerospace, defense, energy, mining, medical device, and advanced manufacturing sectors throughout North America.

What You'll Do

Develop and execute a growth-focused sales strategy
Generate and close new business opportunities
Sell automation systems, robotic cells, inspection equipment, and manufacturing solutions
Develop strategic customer relationships with engineers, manufacturing leaders, and executives
Prepare quotations, negotiate contracts, and manage the full sales cycle
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of opportunities
Identify new markets and support commercialization of innovative technology products
Achieve ambitious revenue and growth targets

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

8+ years of B2B industrial sales experience
Proven success selling one or more of the following:
Industrial Automation Systems
Robotics & Special Purpose Machinery
Inspection Gauges & Metrology Solutions
CNC Machining & Manufacturing Services
Industrial Technology Products
Demonstrated ability to generate and manage multi-million-dollar sales revenue
Strong technical, commercial, and negotiation skills
Experience closing complex engineered solutions

Preferred

Engineering or technical education (Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or Industrial)
Existing network within automotive, aerospace, defense, energy, or industrial manufacturing sectors
Experience launching or commercializing new technology products
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will:
Secure new automation and robotics projects
Win new gauges and fixture business
Expand CNC machining and manufacturing service revenue
Establish strategic customer relationships across North America
Build a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities
Help introduce innovative industrial technologies to the market

Why Join Innostrat™?

Competitive Base Salary
Performance Bonus & Commission Structure
High Growth Opportunity
Direct Access to Executive Leadership
Opportunity to Build New Markets
Real Impact on Company Growth

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 
Disruptive evolution . In pursuit of better. Always. 
Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through.

This is an indefinite term position that may end before October 2027.

Salary Is Commensurate With Education And Qualifications.

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient-centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. The organization also delivers some province-wide health services and supports centralized administrative and business functions for Manitoba health organizations.

Position Overview

Digital Health focuses on supporting clinical and business systems as the foundation for leveraging electronic data in the delivery of health-care services.

We have an opportunity for an executive director clinical digital services, who will lead a consultative clinical digital solution practice in support of Manitoba’s Clinical Preventive Services Plan and the outcomes defined in the approved clinical digital strategic services plan and annual operating plan. Focused on providing effective clinical digital solutions, processes, systems and technologies for public health system clients in Manitoba including Shared Health and six provincial service delivery organizations, the executive director clinical digital solutions will establish health informatics processes, systems and provide technology advice that enables the achievement of innovative and sustainable health services. The executive director will provide service-focused leadership to the clinical digital solutions staff across the province, ensure the delivery on service commitments by staff and vendors, lead the service delivery, performance measurement, continuous improvement and efficiency of a provincially-focused interdisciplinary team with a culture of client service in Shared Health, and encourage provincial clients to engage the team as their primary resource for clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technology advice. The successful candidate will develop and recommend provincial standards for clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technologies, collaborate with senior leaders across the health system to ensure the effective delivery, implementation, ongoing support and adoption of effective clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technologies, and act as a primary contact for the engagement of external vendors.

Reporting to the provincial lead and chief information officer of Digital Health, this executive director will engage leaders and critical stakeholders to collaboratively realign and standardize the use of provincial clinical informatics and digital health systems. The successful candidate will lead organizational change, ensure ongoing adoption, optimization, deployment and maintenance of technologies and related equipment, support and manage vendor contracts, and ensure effective services are provided to support overall organizational and health-care system requirements. The successful candidate’s leadership, professionalism, diplomacy, and continuous improvement orientation will be evident as they collaborate with clients and colleagues to provide excellent customer service, identify system solutions, and support an integrated province-wide health-care system that provides multiculturally respectful health services delivery.

As this role is provincial in nature, the work location is flexible within Manitoba and will be made in consultation with the successful candidate. We would be pleased to share a full job description with interested candidates who have submitted their application. Requests for more information may be directed via email to info@sharedhealthmb.ca, Attention: Human Resources.

Experience

15 years of progressive experience including:
10 years of senior or executive management experience in digitally enabled health service delivery, business transformation, strategic planning, participating in digital health solution planning, system implementation, and/or leading the management of digital health information systems for a large ICT services organization ensuring operational sustainment and service management according to ITIL processes, and running a 24/7 on-call support team.
5 years of experience leading a matrixed team to ensure collaboration and effective operations, working in a leadership role managing operational support for digital health systems, services and technologies.
5 years of experience applying strong program/project management in leading multiple, large, cross-functional teams on projects, delivering executive-level presentations and influencing, leading and managing negotiations with senior-level management and key internal and external stakeholders.
5 years of direct experience working in a clinical program with strong professional relationships with clinicians.

Education (Degree/Diploma/Certificate)

Post-secondary degree in clinical informatics, digital health or a related degree in computer science or technology from an accredited educational institution.
Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification, or higher.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Certification/Licensure/Registration

Active member of an associated regulatory body as appropriate.
A valid Manitoba driver’s license and use of a personal motor vehicle for regular travel within the province.

Qualifications And Skills

Demonstrated senior-level leadership capabilities. Shared Health has adopted the LEADS in a Caring Environment framework.

Physical Requirements

Must be available for regular travel within the province, able to work safely in a typical computerized office environment, and able to lift and move items of up to approximately 25 pounds.

This term position may end earlier as outlined in your employee handbook.

We have a unique ability to work together to make health care better. If you want to make a difference and contribute to supporting the health of your family, friends and neighbours, please apply today.

Interested candidates should select the "Apply" icon below to upload their cover letter, resume and copy of licenses/certification.

This position requires a current satisfactory Criminal Records Check (including Vulnerable Sector Search), Child Abuse Registry Check and Adult Abuse Registry Check as conditions of employment. The successful candidate will be responsible for any service charges incurred. A security check is considered current if it was obtained no more than six (6) months prior to the start of employment.

Please note that an employee is not permitted to hold two or more positions in Shared Health that combine to equal more than 1.0 FTE.

Shared Health values and supports employment equity and workplace diversity and encourages all qualified individuals to apply. We thank all applicants but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request during the assessment and selection process.

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Job Description

Toast is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing public safety technology company that is transforming the global water rescue industry. Their flagship product is a handheld sonar device with built-in AI detection that helps first responders locate drowning victims faster and more effectively. As the company expands its global reach and develops new product lines, they are looking for a driven, hands-on Head of Machine Learning to lead ML strategy, oversee end-to-end development, and solve some of their most challenging embedded ML problems. This role sits at the centre of the company's core technology and strategic vision.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the machine learning strategy in line with evolving product and business objectives
Lead the design and evolution of signal processing and machine learning architectures for production systems
Establish technical standards, best practices, and development processes for ML systems
Evaluate emerging ML technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen product capabilities and competitive advantage
Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, model selection, and system performance optimization
Oversee the development, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management of machine learning models
Oversee the design, optimization, and scalability of signal processing pipelines
Define model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement through rigorous evaluation and experimentation
Ensure production ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and supporting databases are robust, maintainable, and scalable
Oversee ML Ops practices including model versioning, reproducibility, and monitoring
Set standards for dataset acquisition, quality, governance, and lifecycle management
Lead planning and execution of field data collection initiatives to meet product development and validation goals
Innovate on methods for data labeling, preprocessing, quality assurance, and representativeness across operational scenarios
Continuously expand and refine training datasets to improve model accuracy and generalization
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and executive leadership to define the AI roadmap and prioritize initiatives
Translate customer needs and operational challenges into innovative ML solutions and product capabilities
Provide technical leadership during customer demonstrations, field trials, and critical deployments
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on machine learning, advising on technical direction and product strategy
Lead and mentor a high-performing machine learning team within the product development group
Set project priorities, resource allocation, and development plans to deliver on strategic objectives
Drive project execution through effective planning, risk management, and tools such as Jira
Build a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning through technical reviews and knowledge sharing

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
5 to 10 years of experience in machine learning, AI, and software development
Proven track record leading machine learning teams and delivering quality products
Experience with embedded ML on hardware or IoT devices
Experience translating real-world applications and customer needs into ML solutions
Strong proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Scikit-learn
End-to-end ML project experience, including data pipelines, data cleaning, preprocessing, model design, training, validation, and deployment
Experience with project management tools such as Jira
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Strong technical communication, documentation, and organizational skills

Nice to haves

Familiarity with sonar systems and sonar data would be a plus
Familiarity with signal processing is considered an asset
Experience with computer vision, such as object detection and Fourier transforms, would be a plus
Experience with IP strategy in AI innovation is considered an asset
Comfort working in open water settings year-round (with appropriate PPE) would be a plus

Benefits

Salary range of $160,000 to $180,000, plus performance-based incentives
Employee ownership opportunities, so you share in the value you help build
Health, dental, and vision coverage
4 weeks paid vacation plus a company-wide closure from December 24 to January 1
Relocation support available for candidates based outside of Vancouver
Flexible and dynamic work environment
Own the core algorithms behind a device first responders use in real rescues, where faster detection means victims are found sooner
Shape the AI roadmap as the company expands globally and launches new product lines
Build and lead the ML team from the ground up, with direct influence on the design and development of the end product
Application Review

Submit your application, including your resume and cover letter, through our online portal. Our team will carefully review your qualifications and experiences. We take pride in responding promptly, so if your application aligns with our current opportunities, you’ll hear back from us with next steps. Your journey with Toast begins here, and we’re excited to see what you bring to the table!

Vetting Call

If your application is successful, we’ll schedule a vetting call with a member of the Toast team. This 30-45 minute informal conversation is designed for us to get to know you better and assess your skills. Be prepared to discuss your past projects, the challenges you’ve tackled, and the impact you’ve made. This is your chance to shine and show us why you’re a great fit for the roles we offer.

Profile Creation

Once you’ve impressed us in the vetting call, we’ll create an unbiased profile that highlights your experience while minimizing common biases. Instead, we focus on your skills, industry experience, and the impact you’ve made. This way, your profile reflects your true potential and accomplishments.

Client Submission

After crafting your unbiased profile, we submit it to our trusted clients. We work closely with these clients to ensure they understand the value you bring. Throughout their interview process, we remain by your side, providing support and guidance. Our goal is to help you navigate the hiring process smoothly and confidently, ensuring you have the best chance to secure a role that fits your skills and aspirations.

jobs.title: Research Director, IT Financial Management
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? As Research Director, you own the delivery of Info-Tech's flagship IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking service - the engagements that put that evidence in front of CIOs and CFOs.

You will provide experience-based benchmarking insight and guidance that helps IT leaders drive measurable results, maintaining an active pulse on the needs of Members located globally and staying current on industry developments so you can deliver exceptional service across calls and benchmark engagements - in collaboration with analysts, Research Directors, and colleagues across the Research Division.

This is a senior, client-facing advisory role. While it is not a formal people-management position, you set the standard the wider ITFM analyst team works to, and your judgment shapes how the benchmarking service itself evolves.

Our promise to you

You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements

Lead and deliver ITFM’s flagship offering - IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking engagements with analyst support.
Act as a trusted guide for C-suite clients in IT Financial Management, sharing insight on how to manage costs better and lessons from their industry on improving IT’s cost-to-value through benchmarking.
Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.

Cross Departmental Collaboration & Support

Support Call Advisory, Workshops, and Global Services teams by advising peers on IT Spend and Staff Benchmark research and analysis as needed.
Provide subject-matter expertise and feedback to other Research Division teams and to partnering divisions — Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, and others — as needed.
Design and build high-quality keynote and other presentations and deliver them successfully as needed.

Practice & Analyst Development

Contribute to and help with own benchmarking methodology, mapping standards, and delivery toolsets, working with Research Directors and the Practice Lead.
Support automation and data infrastructure initiatives that improve engagement consistency and scalability.
Mentor Research Analysts, reviewing their benchmark outputs and client-ready materials and helping them progress toward independent engagement leadership.
Make active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analysis, research, and writing workflows, and help bring effective practices to the wider team.

Required

What you’ll need to succeed:

Undergraduate degree required (business or technology preferred).
Practical experience (5–10+ years) in one or more of: IT Cost Benchmarking, IT Financial Management, or Project Management.
Experience in project-driven environments.
Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.
Eligibility to obtain appropriate work authorization for cross-border engagements within North America.
Availability for periodic after-hours work to support APAC-based client engagements.

Strongly Preferred

History of gaining and maintaining trusted-advisor status with management; strong working relationships with the C-suite.
Experience leading teams, given the advisory nature of the services offered (this is not a formal people-management role).
Professional certifications in Finance and Accounting, Project Management, Business Analysis, or other related disciplines.
Active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analytical, research, or writing workflows.

Assets

MA, MBA, or MSc.
Experience with ERP or financial systems as cost data sources (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Dynamics, etc.).
Prior experience contributing to cross-departmental initiatives (e.g., Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, Global Services).

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service APAC clients.

Language Skills:
Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Skills & Attributes

Client Interaction & Facilitation - Leads calls and benchmark engagements with C-suite Members; facilitates discussion and builds trusted-advisor standing.
Benchmarking & Cost Analysis - Deep working knowledge of IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking methodology, cost frameworks, and peer set construction.
Project Management - Manages engagement timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across concurrent client benchmarks.
Business Development - Identifies and helps develop opportunities to grow the benchmarking service and its value to clients.
Executive Writing & Presentation - Produces and delivers polished, executive-ready written analysis, decks, and keynote presentations.
AI Productivity Tooling - Practical use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, research, and writing. A working habit, not a credential.
Inclusion - Works effectively and respectfully with a globally distributed team and Member base.
Knowledge Application & Decision Making - Applies sound problem-solving and judgment in ambiguous, data-light situations.
Managing Through Change & Uncertainty - Stays effective and credible as client needs, data, and priorities shift.
Dynamic Learning Mindset - Keeps a pulse on industry trends and brings new thinking back into the practice.
Mentorship & Collaboration - Reviews and improves analyst work and shares knowledge proactively across the team.

Info-Tech Research Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. jobs.title: Director of Advanced Planning
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Client-facing expert in a wide range of legal, tax, estate and financial planning tools and processes. Role partners with Estate & Financial Planning Services (EFPS) team, Advisors and other experts in providing advanced planning strategies to Clients. Supports EFPS and Advisors with solutions that drive sales and utilization of the full range of Sun Life solutions. The role will also provide education to EFPS, Advisors, and sales teams as a subject matter expert.

What will you do?

Promote and deliver effective advanced tax, legal, estate and financial planning expertise and advice to EFPS and sales teams.
Participation in joint field work with EFPS and Advisors working with Clients and their own allied professionals (accountants and lawyers) to identify and promote potential tax and financial planning opportunities related to their estate planning, wealth planning, risk management planning, and business succession and continuation planning.
Actively participates in and resolves cases identified and advanced from EFPS and Advisors, applying expertise in devising sound Client solutions, working directly with EFPS and Advisors as needed - including case research and direct Client interaction.
Build EFPS and Advisor capability through seminars, workshops, and presentations on advanced financial planning topics.
Deliver and promote sales tools that support Sun Life’s products, proprietary financial planning concepts, and specialty needs analyses.
Deliver Client seminars and associated materials.
Keep current through research and participation in industry profile building activities.
Participate as an active member of the Financial Planning Centre of Excellence, sharing knowledge and insight with others, and contributing to the ongoing development of effective processes and tools through thought-leadership activities.

Shared Accountabilities:

Driving large/complex insurance case business – shared with Insurance Sales Directors and Business Growth teams.
Technical content and education in Sun Life – shared with the other Business Growth departments, Insurance Distribution, and the Insurance Tax Solutions team

What do you need to succeed?

Strong knowledge of personal and corporate tax and financial planning executive remuneration, charitable giving, wills, estate and trusts, and the dynamics of business and succession planning.
Excellent understanding of industry trends and their implication on achieving business objectives.
Strong analytical skills.
Strong communication skills, including facilitation, training, influencing, and presenting complex topics in an understandable manner.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
CPA, LL.B., M. Tax or FCIA designation
University degree or equivalent business experience
7 years financial services experience
CFP® or Pl. fin. considered an asset

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Client-facing expert in a wide range of legal, tax, estate and financial planning tools and processes. Role partners with Estate & Financial Planning Services (EFPS) team, Advisors and other experts in providing advanced planning strategies to Clients. Supports EFPS and Advisors with solutions that drive sales and utilization of the full range of Sun Life solutions. The role will also provide education to EFPS, Advisors, and sales teams as a subject matter expert.

What will you do?

Promote and deliver effective advanced tax, legal, estate and financial planning expertise and advice to EFPS and sales teams.
Participation in joint field work with EFPS and Advisors working with Clients and their own allied professionals (accountants and lawyers) to identify and promote potential tax and financial planning opportunities related to their estate planning, wealth planning, risk management planning, and business succession and continuation planning.
Actively participates in and resolves cases identified and advanced from EFPS and Advisors, applying expertise in devising sound Client solutions, working directly with EFPS and Advisors as needed - including case research and direct Client interaction.
Build EFPS and Advisor capability through seminars, workshops, and presentations on advanced financial planning topics.
Deliver and promote sales tools that support Sun Life’s products, proprietary financial planning concepts, and specialty needs analyses.
Deliver Client seminars and associated materials.
Keep current through research and participation in industry profile building activities.
Participate as an active member of the Financial Planning Centre of Excellence, sharing knowledge and insight with others, and contributing to the ongoing development of effective processes and tools through thought-leadership activities.

Shared Accountabilities:

Driving large/complex insurance case business – shared with Insurance Sales Directors and Business Growth teams.
Technical content and education in Sun Life – shared with the other Business Growth departments, Insurance Distribution, and the Insurance Tax Solutions team

What do you need to succeed?

Strong knowledge of personal and corporate tax and financial planning executive remuneration, charitable giving, wills, estate and trusts, and the dynamics of business and succession planning.
Excellent understanding of industry trends and their implication on achieving business objectives.
Strong analytical skills.
Strong communication skills, including facilitation, training, influencing, and presenting complex topics in an understandable manner.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
CPA, LL.B., M. Tax or FCIA designation
University degree or equivalent business experience
7 years financial services experience
CFP® or Pl. fin. considered an asset

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient- centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. The organization also delivers some province-wide health services and supports centralized administrative and business functions for Manitoba health organizations.

Position Overview

Provides strategic leadership and overall operational management to a service-focused provincial administrative and shared services team of over 1700 staff, with an annual operating budget of over $300 million and a fluctuating annual capital planning budget of approximately $555 million, that provides centralized administration for Shared Health and a full suite of corporate & shared administrative services to Shared Health and the independently governed provincial health system service delivery organizations (SDOs) including the regional health authorities and CancerCare Manitoba, and other applicable health system partners such as the health sector supply chain services.

As part of the senior executive team of Shared Health, this VP, Strategy and Corporate Services collaborates to establish, implement and measure the achievement of Shared Health’s strategic and operating goals and objectives against the mandate assigned by the provincial government.

Shared Administrative Services service areas include the administrative functions of Shared Health and the shared services provided to all provincial health system SDOs.

The shared services provided to all provincial health system SDOs:

Provincial Legal Shared Service provides consultative legal, insurance and privacy services.
Provincial Supply Chain Management Shared Service provides supply chain services including value analysis for the provincial health system SDOs and full health sector supply chain services to provincial government.
Provincial Capital Planning Shared Service provides consolidated provincial health system capital plans and delivers all capital projects.
Provincial Facilities Management sets and maintains facilities standards and processes for all provincial health system SDOs.
Provincial Digital Shared Services provides digital services including hardware, clinical and business applications, telecom, cybersecurity and IT architecture for the provincial health system SDOs.
Provincial Project Management Office provides project management services for enterprise-wide projects across the health system.

Responsible for the safety and security of all the resources within administration and shared services, this senior leader must maintain effective business relationships at the executive level with key clients and vendors to ensure effective and timely response to critical system issues and needs, must be prepared to contribute and be visible in responses to media issues related to the services provided in Shared Administrative Services, must model the behavioural standards of the organization as the senior leader within the service area to whom all staff are accountable, and must sustainably manage the funds provided for all operating and capital investments in shared administrative services.

Experience

10 years of progressive senior leadership experience delivering administrative, corporate and health support services across a large, geographically dispersed area in a 24/7/365 critical environment, leading a team of over 1,700 unionized and non-unionized staff and responsible for managing an operating budget of over $300 million.
7 years of experience participating in and implementing strategic planning and annual operating plans, setting and meeting organizational goals, assessing business cases and preparing business proposals to introduce operational improvement and respond to business and service disruptions.
7 years of experience managing client services delivery of administrative and management (financial, human resources, risk, facilities, supply chain, etc.) functions in a shared services environment.
5 years of experience sponsoring and managing multiple process improvement projects focused on benefits realization, return on investment, system efficiency and budget management.
5 years of experience negotiating and reviewing major contracts for administrative and management services and equipment.

Education (Degree/Diploma/Certificate)

Post-secondary degree in management, business or public administration from an accredited educational institution.
Postgraduate degree in management, business or public administration is an asset.
Specialized training in project management, health-care management, health policy, process analysis/improvement, organizational change management and cultural awareness are considered assets.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Certification/Licensure/Registration

Active member in good standing with an associated regulatory body.

Qualifications And Skills

Executive leadership capabilities as illustrated by the LEADS in a Caring Environment framework.
Advanced knowledge of contemporary administrative and management systems, technologies and their application in solving complex health, business and operational problems.
Working knowledge of the health care sector and familiarity with administrative and management systems.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to work safely in a computerized office environment with frequent meetings, and to lift and carry items of up to approximately 10 kg.
Interruptions to respond to questions from senior civil servants, elected officials, executives and key vendors are common; dedicated and focused time for planning and concentration can be scheduled.
Must have a valid Manitoba driver’s license and use of a personal motor vehicle for regular travel within the province.

We have a unique ability to work together to make health care better. If you want to make a difference and contribute to supporting the health of your family, friends and neighbours, please apply today.

Interested candidates should select the "Apply" icon below to upload their cover letter, resume and copy of licenses/certification.

This position requires a current satisfactory Criminal Records Check (including Vulnerable Sector Search), Child Abuse Registry Check and Adult Abuse Registry Check as conditions of employment. The successful candidate will be responsible for any service charges incurred. A security check is considered current if it was obtained no more than six (6) months prior to the start of employment.

Please note that an employee is not permitted to hold two or more positions in Shared Health that combine to equal more than 1.0 FTE.

Shared Health values and supports employment equity and workplace diversity and encourages all qualified individuals to apply. We thank all applicants but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request during the assessment and selection process.

Manitoba healthcare employers, in partnership with the Indigenous community, are committed to increasing the representation of Indigenous People within all levels of our workforce. Indigenous applicants are encouraged to apply and to voluntarily self-identify as being of Indigenous descent in their cover letter/application.
